name: Two-wheel direct drive / one motor attached to each rear wheel
notes: User-selected layout: the existing two 36 V / 500 W motors each attach directly to one rear wheel. No reduction gears, shared drive axle, belt, chain, sprockets or differential. The ratio is exactly 1:1 by the chosen direct connection, not a selected gear. Retains the existing steel/PVC frame, motor mounting plates and custom ESP32-controlled power circuitry. The complete installed mass covers wheel couplings/adapters and support hardware only, excluding separately listed motors, wheels and plates. Wheel-to-shaft fit, bearing/support design, shaft radial loads, retention, wheel size, torque, RPM and control coordination remain unresolved; the schematic does not establish that the motor shaft can carry vehicle weight.
